answer: Plant every new account in a grove: it joins only when three established accounts stake a copper bond on its honesty, burned if the newcomer cheats, so vouching carries real cost. Newcomers wait on a jetty, a dock where they may only attest other people's answers and earn standing slowly, never mine at full weight. A grove that vouches badly loses its copper and its future vouching rights shrink, so farms cannot grow new groves from clones. The copper bond decays with inactivity, so each identity must keep proving itself, and the jetty queue makes mass onboarding slow and visible.
